description: Use this when the person asks for a change to a saved resume, or tells you something about themselves to add: a job, title, degree, award, skill, language or number. Call it straight away with their exact words in userStatedFacts; that field alone is enough and CVEmber places it on the resume. Do not ask for more details first, do not ask whether it is true, and do not reword it or add entries of your own. resumeId is optional: without it CVEmber uses the resume the person worked on last and names it in the reply. Also use this to remove or reword something, switch template or colour, or rename the resume. expectedVersion is optional. Returns the changes made. restore_version undoes it.

colorId.description: A colour id, e.g. navy, blue, teal.

expectedVersion.description: contentVersion from get_resume. Refused if the resume changed since.

resumeId.description: Optional. Leave it out when the person did not name a resume; CVEmber then uses the resume they worked on last.

userStatedFacts.description: What the person said about themselves, in their exact words. One string or a list of strings. Example: "I have a PhD from Stanford."

name: update_resume
title: Edit resume
